caption_used: Massive activation values across layers under baseline conditions, showing four component signals. The ffn_residual (red solid) and attn_residual (orange dotted) lines rise sharply at layer 5 to approximately 1400, with ffn_residual maintaining values between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20 before declining. The attn_residual closely mirrors ffn_residual but with a one-layer rightward shift. The ffn_output (green dash-dot) exhibits periodic spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, reaching peak values of approximately 800. The attn_output (blue dashed) remains near zero throughout all layers, with no notable increase at any point in the network. The data indicates that massive activations in the baseline are driven primarily by the feed-forward network residual stream, with attention outputs contributing negligibly.

raw_responses.Bulgarian:
The chart displays four distinct signal lines plotted against layer number on the x-axis and maximum activation value on the y-axis, illustrating the behavior of different components across layers in a neural network under baseline conditions.

The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and ranges from 0 to 20, with integer tick marks at each whole number. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and ranges from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200 (0, 200, 400, ..., 1600).

The four data series are:
- The "attn_output" (blue dashed line) remains near zero throughout the entire range, with values consistently below 200 and showing no significant increase.
- The "attn_residual" (orange dotted line) rises sharply starting at layer 5, reaching approximately 1400, and remains relatively stable between layers 5 and 20 before declining slightly toward layer 20.
- The "ffn_output" (green dash-dot line) exhibits periodic spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, with peak values reaching approximately 800. Between these spikes, its value is near zero.
- The "ffn_residual" (red solid line) rises sharply starting at layer 5, reaching approximately 1400, and remains relatively stable between layers 5 and 20, maintaining values between 1400 and 1600 before declining slightly toward layer 20.

The attn_output remains near zero. The attn_residual and ffn_residual both rise sharply at layer 5 to approximately 1400 and remain high until layer 20. The ffn_output shows periodic spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, peaking at approximately 800.
raw_responses.Chinese:
This line chart, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," displays four distinct signal traces plotted against the layer index (x-axis) and their corresponding maximum activation values (y-axis). The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 20 with uniform integer spacing. The y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value," ranges from 0 to 1600 with uniform spacing of 200 units. The chart includes four lines: the "attn_output" is a blue dashed line; the "attn_residual" is an orange dotted line; the "ffn_output" is a green dash-dot line; and the "ffn_residual" is a red solid line. The red solid line ("ffn_residual") begins at 0, rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, remains between 1400 and 1600 until layer 20, then declines to approximately 600 at layer 22. The orange dotted line ("attn_residual") closely follows the red line but is shifted one layer to the right, reaching approximately 1400 at layer 6 and remaining above 1400 until layer 21. The green dash-dot line ("ffn_output") remains near zero until layer 5, then spikes to approximately 800 at layer 5, dips to near zero, spikes again to approximately 800 at layer 13, dips again to near zero, and spikes to approximately 1200 at layer 22. The blue dashed line ("attn_output") remains near zero throughout the entire range, with values consistently below 50 across all layers.
